title: MimicX: Policy-in-the-Loop Supervision Refinement for Humanoid Motion Tracking
titleZh: MimicX：面向人形机器人运动跟踪的策略在环监督优化
short_description: MimicX turns human videos into humanoid motion skills and uses policy execution feedback to refine training supervision. It locates difficult motion intervals and body regions, adapts tracking objectives and practice curricula, and keeps improvements verified through repeated rollouts. MimicX-HLoop accelerates feedback by overlapping GPU execution and CPU diagnosis.
shortDescriptionZh: MimicX 从人类视频中学习人形机器人运动，并利用策略执行反馈持续优化训练监督。方法定位困难动作片段与身体部位，联合调整跟踪目标和训练课程，通过重复执行验证筛选改进；MimicX-HLoop 则通过 GPU 执行与 CPU 诊断的重叠调度加快反馈。
